comment: Shared by tests/test_state_contract.py (bin/sinko parse_state) and tests/state-contract.test.js (web parseState): both must normalise every input to exactly this.

cases.name: empty string
not json
json but not an object
legacy state: only timer and schedule (2.x)
a complete valid update block
an update block full of bad values
update.error is trimmed to 200 characters and blank errors are dropped
blank error
release notes link: only github.com releases pages
release notes link with extra path is refused
release notes link on another host is refused
a request marker may be a short string
a request marker over 40 characters or equal to 0 is dropped
power: a valid reboot request
power: poweroff
power: unknown action is dropped
power: an action without a request is dropped
telemetry answered yes
telemetry answered no
telemetry: only a real boolean counts
community: valid
community: a fractional count is floored
community: negative count is refused
community: text instead of numbers is refused
setup done
setup: only a real true counts
learn switched on
learn switched off
learn: only a real true counts
learn: text is not true
learn: a list instead of an object is ignored
unknown top-level keys are dropped
a NaN token makes the whole description garbage, as JSON.parse does
an Infinity token makes the whole description garbage
timer.snapshot.services as a list does not crash and is dropped
timer.snapshot.services as text does not crash and is dropped
timer.snapshot as a list is treated as empty
timer.snapshot.services values use Python bool()
timer.until true is not a number
timer.until as text is not a number
timer.mode must be free or block
schedule.days: whole floats count, booleans, text and fractions do not, and duplicates go
schedule times must be two ASCII digits, a colon, two ASCII digits
schedule times with Arabic-Indic digits are refused
schedule times with a trailing newline are refused
schedule times out of range are refused
schedule times that are valid are kept
scheduleActive and enabled use Python bool(): empty list false, non-empty object true
a version with a trailing newline is refused
a version in Arabic-Indic digits is refused
release notes with a trailing newline are refused
update.error that is only a byte order mark is blank
update.error that is only a no-break space is blank
update.error with a next-line control character is not blank
update.error is cut at 200 characters, not 200 UTF-16 units
a request marker of 40 astral characters is kept, 41 is dropped
update.rolledBack true
update.rolledBack false
update.rolledBack must be a real boolean
update.rolledBack 1 is not a boolean
timer.until of 400 digits is Infinity to the page: not a number, the timer is dropped, the rest stays
timer.until of 5000 digits does not make the whole text garbage (Python's integer limit is not the page's)
timer.until of minus 400 digits is not a number either
timer.until as a number with exponent 999 is Infinity
update.checked of 400 digits is dropped to 0
update.at of 400 digits is dropped to 0
update.at of minus 400 digits is not a count
update.request and update.checkRequest of 400 digits are no markers
power.request of 400 digits is no marker, so there is no power action
community.online of 400 digits is not a count
community.at of 400 digits is not a number
community.at of 5000 digits is not a number
a big integer that a double holds (1e30) is that double, in every place a number is read
a number that is Infinity on the page is no number even inside a list of bedtime days
